whyItMatters: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `nodeLinker: pnp` setting.
actions: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a `nodeLinker: pnp` setting.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm .yarnrc.yml no longer carries a `nodeLinker: pnp` setting.
